posts.name: Sedocoi
posts.cooked:
Think of how much more fun arena would be if healers just werent allowed? Its a new spin, DPS only comps. CMon blizzard, this charade boring.

I carried people in the OG TBC on resto druid to 1800 all the time. Easiest class I have ever played in my life. Also probably the most fun because you are a literal god unshackled by the woes of roots and slows, are given one of the strongest CCs in the game, and the pillar is your BAE.
Seeing this all play out again, but this time im maining frost mage. I cant help but wonder how different the game would be if everyone had to play a damage specialization in arena.
TBH my biggest want is just shorter matches. Ever seen two healers fight to the death? ugh. its bad.
Also, healers- DO you WANT to heal in arena in TBC? Or would you rather have some zergy zug zug matches? Just some thoughts.
